$comment: Describes classifier_a_c4v003.py, sha256 394a8b6116b4cbb795de303a7a51778b671b39599cd7df5e032cadc97f7946e5 (claude_artifacts/classifier_a_c4/build_c4v003/). Schema only: no implementation and no expected case output. Companions: OUTPUT_CONSTANTS_C4V003.json (every literal string, grouped by the field that carries it, with the function it comes from) and README_SCHEMA_C4V003.md, which lists the DELTA against OUTPUT_SCHEMA_C4V002.json.
title: OUTPUT_SCHEMA_C4V003: the output object of classifier_a_c4v003 (output schema string CLASSIFIER_A_OUTPUT_C4V001)
description: Every object classifier_a_c4v003 can write, read from its code (classify_bundle, Run.run, Run.prescore_output, Run.score_output and the helpers that add keys). FORMS (oneOf, disjoint): form_refused_bundle and form_refused_internal_error (classify_bundle); form_no_classification (Run.run, either mode); form_prescore (mode prescore); form_score_blanked (mode score with at least one ALL-class stop, the text's 'every other' class); form_score_phase1 and form_score_phase2 (mode score without one). BYTES: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) plus one newline, so the members of every object (echoed ones included) are written in sorted key order (code-point order) whatever order is listed here, and non-ASCII characters are \u-escaped; lists keep the order their ORDER notes state. Numbers are Python's: an integer input stays an integer, a median of two values is a float, floats print in repr form. NOTES used in descriptions: SOURCE: the function that writes the value; ORDER: the order of a list; ABSENT: how a missing or blanked value is written, one of (a) the object {"NOT_AVAILABLE": [codes]} (the code's na(): codes sorted in code-point order, no repeats), (b) the bare string "NOT_AVAILABLE", (c) null, (d) the key omitted; ECHO: copied from an input without validation, so its inner form is the producer's, not the classifier's. "UNDEFINED" is a value (a quantity the text defines as undefined), never an absent marker.

schema_const.description: SOURCE: module constant OUT_SCHEMA (the c4v001 string, kept; README contract C5 changes content, not the string).

qid.description: A query id (module constant QIDS, C-I1): NGC3198-Q01 to NGC3198-Q43.

qid_q25.description: The one flagged row (module constant FLAGGED_IDS, C-1.4).

zone.description: Zone words (module constant ZONES; zone by id from ZONE_TABLE, C-1.3).

hex64_ci.description: 64 hex in either case (is_hex64_ci, V-F1), printed in its input case.

utc.description: ECHO of a `date -u` ISO time as parse_utc accepts it: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, an optional '.' with a fraction, then Z. parse_utc tests the digit groups with str.isdigit and int(), so some non-ASCII decimal digits also pass; the pattern states the ASCII form. Field ranges are not checked.

e3_value.description: The C-5.3 E3 value (Run.engine; module constant E3_NEGATIVE for the first, V-F2).

tier.description: Rule M-T tier (C-1.1): a LATE-gate row prints INVALID_AS_MISS.

reading_kind.description: Module constant KIND_NAME over the kinds H, MS, MN, I, L.

field_map_status.description: SOURCE: Run.load_inputs (field_map_status): NOT_SUPPLIED when the bundle's field_map role is null; FIELD_MAP_DEFECT_NOT_APPLIED when the map is unreadable or malformed; FIELD_MAP_DEFECT_PARTIAL when a rename was refused (onto an existing key); APPLIED otherwise.

stop_code.description: Every code Run.stop is called with (C-1.1; the F5 names). Listed in code-point order, the order of stops[] and status_code.

stop_code_all_class.description: The codes of class ALL ('every other').

load_status.description: SOURCE: Run.load_inputs / Run.read_pinned (load_err), printed by Run.prescore_output as `load_err or 'READ'`. READ means the bytes matched the pin and parsed (not that the content is valid). JSON_DEFECT: carries the strict loader's word (strict_loads, _pairs, _const, _float).

na_all.description: A blanked output under an 'every other' stop (Run.score_output): the codes of every ALL-class stop that fired (Run.codes('ALL')); the same object for every blanked item of one output.

na_d.description: An output computed from a defective reference row (classes ROW and GATE, C-1.1 map; codes_d = Run.codes('ROW', 'GATE')). The list is non-empty wherever a defective row exists; the one place it can print empty is readings R-UT1/R-REACH part1 when S(OUTER) is DEFICIT, no OUTER MISS row has a negative ratio and none of P2, P14, P11 holds with no defective row (reachable only from HIT rows with sigma_ratio < -1, which the classifier does not cross-check against within_error).

na_near.description: NEAR (or a count built from NEAR) not available: the row codes of a defective row, FIELD_DEFECT_ENVELOPE for a tier-MISS row named by an envelope stop (basis row T3: a HIT or INVALID row so named prints near false and does not blank N), ENVELOPE_ROW_INVALID for a tier-MISS row whose envelope row is invalid (F1).

na_tsr.description: Blanked by TSR_FLAG_TABLE_MISMATCH (class TSR: P10, R-TSR and the flag column only).

na_band.description: SOURCE: Run.band_column. Exactly one code. A record-level code (L1_SHA_MISMATCH, L1_RECORD_DEFECT, PHASE1_TOOL_PIN_DEFECT) blanks all 43 rows alike; Q01_Q02_ALWAYS_NOT_AVAILABLE only on Q01 and Q02 (M-16); the row codes L1_ROW_DEFECT, L1_ROW_NOT_AVAILABLE, TARGET_PAIR_DEFECT on the rows concerned.

na_drift_part1.description: R-DRIFT part 1 not available: codes_d united with the STAGE0 state's codes (Run.readings: part1 = na(codes_d | s0g_codes)); in Phase 1 this includes NOT_IN_PHASE_1.

ipr_main.description: I per reason (C-2; Run.zone_out): {reason: count of INVALID_AS_MISS rows of kind I in the zone} (LATE-gate rows are not counted here). Keys are the rows' registered reasons (built-in words or gate reasons, ECHO). ABSENT: an entry reads {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when a defective row of the zone could be INVALID with that reason; the whole object is {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when such a row's frozen reason is unknown; {} when the zone has no INVALID row.

ipr_twin.description: I per reason of a classified twin (no defective row): {reason: count}; {} when none.

incomplete_reasons.description: SOURCE: Run.labels. ECHO of the score's incomplete_reasons (strings), sorted in code-point order, repeats kept. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [FIELD_DEFECT_OUTSIDE_ROWS]} when that field is not a list of strings.

gate.description: ECHO of the N-test compare's n_route_ab_gate when it is a string other than OPEN. ABSENT: the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE when the compare is not an object or the value is not a string.

code.description: null for a well-formed EXPLORATORY commitment record; COMMITMENT_STATUS_DEFECT for a missing or malformed one (Run.commitment).

label.description: ECHO of the fallback record's classification_label.

labels.description: SOURCE: Run.labels (C-I6, C-I7, M-8). The same list is printed at the top level and inside every zone summary, pattern block, reading, e3_line, STAGE0 comparison and twin classification. ORDER: (1) PROVISIONAL (PHASE-1, FREEZE_INCOMPLETE) when the phase is PHASE_1, otherwise PROVISIONAL (FREEZE_INCOMPLETE) when the score's freeze_status is FREEZE_INCOMPLETE; (2) PROVISIONAL (N_GATE_NOT_OPEN) when the N-test compare's n_route_ab_gate is not the string OPEN; (3) EXPLORATORY (PHASE 2 NOT AS COMMITTED) when the phase is PHASE_2 and the commitment status reads EXPLORATORY; (4) the fallback record's classification_label when the fallback input is an object whose classification_label is one of its two words (read whatever its applies says). Each at most once. ABSENT: [] when none applies.

stop.description: SOURCE: Run.stop, Run.stops_out. code: the C-1.1 stop code (F5 names); class: the stop-to-output map class, fixed per code (allOf below); alternative: the alternative name for class ALT, else null; detail: the stop's detail strings, sorted in code-point order without repeats, each from a fixed template (OUTPUT_CONSTANTS_C4V003.json group stops[].detail; several templates format input values, so the full text is not closed); rows: the query ids the stop concerns, sorted without repeats.

stops.description: SOURCE: Run.stops_out. ORDER: sorted by (code, class, alternative or the empty string) in code-point order. One entry per (code, class, alternative): repeated stops merge, their details and rows united (so FIELD_DEFECT_ROW is one entry naming every defective row, and FIELD_DEFECT_ALTERNATIVE one entry per alternative). For GATE_STATUS_LIST_DEFECT rows lists the INVALID rows whose gate is missing from the list and is empty for a list-level defect only. ABSENT: [] when no stop fired.

status_code_list.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output. The codes of stops[], sorted in code-point order without repeats.

tsr_records.description: SOURCE: Run.header. The three *_sha256 of the flag record, support record and N-test compare are the bundle's pins (ABSENT: null when that role is null in the bundle); n1_record_sha256 and gl_node_record_sha256 are the module constants N1_SHA and NODE_SHA, printed always.

gate_status_list_echo.description: SOURCE: Run.check_gate_list (gate_list_out), printed by Run.header. ECHO of the gate-status list's gates[] in input order (gate_sha256 in its input case, V-F1) when the list holds. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [GATE_STATUS_LIST_DEFECT]} when the list is missing or malformed.

phase1_header_object.description: ECHO of the phase inputs' phase1_header (PHASE_INPUTS_C4V001, as validated by Run._phase_inputs_check).

phase1_header.description: ABSENT: null when the record's phase1_header is null (a Phase 1 refused for PHASE1_HEADER_MISSING prints null). The code's fallback, the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE when the phase inputs are not an object, is not reachable: phase PHASE_1 is only set from a well-formed record.

l1_sha256.description: The bundle's l1_record pin; ABSENT: null when that role is null.

commitment_status.description: SOURCE: Run.commitment (C-I7 commitment status [r3a]). ABSENT: COMMITTED carries no code key; an EXPLORATORY record carries code null; a missing or malformed record reads EXPLORATORY with code COMMITMENT_STATUS_DEFECT and stops_or_changes {NOT_AVAILABLE: [COMMITMENT_STATUS_DEFECT]} (it blanks nothing else). stops_or_changes ORDER: the record's order (ECHO).

stage0_reasons_not_evaluated.description: The reasons of NOT_EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE read from the STAGE0 facts, root's record or the frozen stage0_status block (Run.stage0_status, Run._stage0_facts, M-14, F12). ORDER: STAGE0_RECEIPT_NOT_FINISHED, NO_SEALED_SUCCESSOR, RECEIPTS_AFTER_STEP4, each when it applies (at least one).

stage0_status_defect.description: Run.stage0_status when the STAGE0 status record is missing or malformed (the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE as the status, with its reason).

stage0_status_read.description: Run.stage0_status from well-formed STAGE0 facts (C-6.3 receipt rule, M-14; Run._stage0_facts): read from root's STAGE0 status record (source STAGE0_STATUS_RECORD_C4V003) or, in successor mode, from the frozen manifest's stage0_status block (source FREEZE_MANIFEST_STAGE0_STATUS_BLOCK). phase2_step4_start_utc and receipt_times_utc are ECHO of the source's step4_start_utc and of its members' written_utc, each a time parse_utc accepts or null; receipt_times_utc ORDER: the source's members order (from the block, the frozen PRIMARY members, (member_id, log_index) in order). ABSENT: phase2_step4_start_utc null when the source has null; a receipt time null when that member's written_utc is null. post_score_exploratory: true iff reasons holds RECEIPTS_AFTER_STEP4. Cross-field rules: stage0_read_rules.

stage0_source.description: SOURCE: Run.stage0_status (module constants STAGE0_SOURCE_RECORD, STAGE0_SOURCE_BLOCK). FREEZE_MANIFEST_STAGE0_STATUS_BLOCK: the facts are the frozen manifest's stage0_status block, read in a Phase 2 that the seal runs under the STAGE0 successor (Run.successor_mode: phase PHASE_2 and the bundle's sealed.stage0_successor not null). STAGE0_STATUS_RECORD_C4V003: otherwise, root's STAGE0 status record. ABSENT: the key is omitted in Phase 1 and for a record defect.

stage0_read_rules.description: Cross-field rules of a STAGE0 status read from its facts (Run._stage0_facts, Run.stage0_status), shared by stage0_status_read and the six read cases of stage0_p2. (1) EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE and EVALUATED_REFUSED have no reason, so rule (a) holds: at least one member, every member finished, so each has a receipt time and the step-4 start is a time; and rule (b) holds, which only the block can give: source FREEZE_MANIFEST_STAGE0_STATUS_BLOCK. (2) The record never satisfies rule (b): source STAGE0_STATUS_RECORD_C4V003 always carries NO_SEALED_SUCCESSOR. (3) post_score_exploratory is true iff reasons holds RECEIPTS_AFTER_STEP4, which needs a finished member written after a step-4 start that is a time. (4) A null receipt time is a member not finished: STAGE0_RECEIPT_NOT_FINISHED. (5) A null step-4 start leaves no member finished: with any member, STAGE0_RECEIPT_NOT_FINISHED. (6) The block's rule (a) needs a member (bool(members) and all finished): no member from the block gives STAGE0_RECEIPT_NOT_FINISHED. (7) The record's rule (a) holds over no member: no member from the record gives reasons exactly [NO_SEALED_SUCCESSOR].

stage0_block_defect_word.description: SOURCE: Run._stage0_block_facts and Run._stage0_facts (the word of the ValueError they raise), printed by Run.stage0_status as the block defect's defect and inside the FIELD_DEFECT_ALTERNATIVE detail of STAGE0_GRID_OUTER (Run.prepare_alternatives). Listed in the order the checks run; the member-row checks run member by member. Successor mode only: a record defect prints no word.

stage0_status_block_defect.description: Run.stage0_status in successor mode when the frozen stage0_status block is not bound or malformed (F8: a field of the STAGE0 alternative, TWIN_INPUT_DEFECT; Run.prepare_alternatives adds the FIELD_DEFECT_ALTERNATIVE stop of STAGE0_GRID_OUTER, whose detail names the same word). A record defect prints stage0_status_defect (no source, no defect).

stage0_status_phase2.description: Run.stage0_status in Phase 2: the record defect (stage0_status_defect), the block defect (stage0_status_block_defect, successor mode only), or the status read from the facts (stage0_status_read; source names the record or the block).

stage0_status_phase_null.description: Run.stage0_status with a null phase (the phase inputs were refused): successor mode needs PHASE_2 (Run.successor_mode), so the status is read from root's record, or is the record defect, never from the block.

header.description: SOURCE: Run.header (C-8 item 1). Printed in every score-mode output, under an 'every other' stop too (OC-19). ABSENT per key: phase1 present iff phase is PHASE_1; commitment_status, agree_record_sha256, phase1_classification_sha256 and attestation_scope present iff phase is PHASE_2; score_echo present iff the score parsed to an object; every *_sha256 taken from a bundle pin prints the pinned value even when the file was unreadable or its bytes did not match, and null when the bundle's role is null.

phase.description: The phase the run reads (Run.check_phase): the phase inputs' phase_named; null when the record is missing or malformed; kept when the record is refused only for PHASE1_HEADER_MISSING or RUN_STATUS_NOT_OF_PHASE (OC-27). Equals the top-level phase.

manifest_phase_derived.description: The phase derived from the manifest's calibration_record path (Run.check_phase); null when the check stopped before deriving it.

roster_sha256.description: {roster name: pinned sha256} for every bundle roster (the names are the bundle's keys). ABSENT: {} when the bundle names no roster.

freeze_status.description: ECHO of score.freeze_status: FREEZE_COMPLETE or FREEZE_INCOMPLETE in form_score_phase1/2, any JSON value in form_score_blanked. ABSENT: null when the score object lacks the key; the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE when the score did not parse to an object.

const: D-1: stage-0 outcome S0-FAIL-RHAT; the sealed k = 0 drift reading is SUPPORTED; its causal gloss is UNTESTED (A63; A65.4)
D-2: the coefficient-grid difference (A65): a counted uncertainty for every row
D-3: N1 fails strictly at TRUNCATION_SHAPE ordinal 15; the one flagged row is NGC3198-Q25 (A66; 0550; A90)
disclosures_D1_D3.description: Three fixed strings (Run.header). ORDER: D-1, D-2, D-3.

root_disclosures.description: ECHO of the root_disclosures input object. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [ROOT_DISCLOSURES_NOT_SUPPLIED]} when it is not an object (not supplied, unreadable, or another JSON type).

score_echo.description: ECHO of four score keys. ABSENT: a key the score lacks reads the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE; score_echo itself is omitted when the score did not parse to an object.

attestation_scope.const: Phase 2 attestation covers only the Phase-2-only output values (the calls not re-bound from Phase 1)

stage0_status.description: Run.stage0_status: the fixed Phase-1 form in Phase 1; in Phase 2 read from root's STAGE0 status record, or, when the seal runs Phase 2 under the STAGE0 successor (Run.successor_mode), from the frozen manifest's stage0_status block; with a null phase from the record only (stage0_status_phase_null).

headline_object.description: SOURCE: Run.headline_out (C-I5): the score's headline, ECHO of six keys. ABSENT: a key the headline lacks reads the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE.

headline.description: ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [FIELD_DEFECT_OUTSIDE_ROWS]} when the score's headline is not an object. Printed under an 'every other' stop too (OC-19).

headline_scored.description: The headline when no ALL-class stop fired: Run.check_score has passed, so reference_member_id is a non-empty string and reference_member_log_index an integer.

fallback.description: SOURCE: Run.fallback_out (C-8 item 10). {applies: false} when the bundle's fallback role is null; ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [FALLBACK_RECORD_DEFECT]} when the record is unreadable, not an object, has another schema, or a non-boolean applies; otherwise the whole record, ECHO (only schema and applies are checked).

rows43_order.description: ORDER: 43 entries in query-id order NGC3198-Q01..Q43 (QIDS); id and zone fixed per position (C-1.3: Q01-Q24 INNER, Q25-Q35 TRANSITION, Q36-Q43 OUTER).

rows_stage0_order.description: ORDER: the STAGE0 scoring scope, 8 entries NGC3198-Q36..Q43 (OUTER_IDS), all OUTER.

q03_q15_order.description: ORDER: 13 entries NGC3198-Q03..Q15 (E1_SUBTABLE_IDS, C-5.1), in row order.

row_kind_rules.description: Values fixed by the reading kind (Run.build_rows, sign_of; rule M-T, C-1.2, C-4): HIT and MISS_SIGNED carry the finite ratio r_q and its sign -1/0/+1; MISS_NULL_RATIO has r_q null and sign UNDEFINED; INVALID_AS_MISS and LATE_GATE_MISS have r_q null, sign NONE and the registered reason; only LATE_GATE_MISS has gate_after_predictions true.

row_main_kind_rules.description: Reference-row values fixed by the reading kind (Run.score_output): frozen_prediction true for HIT and the two MISS kinds; tier_key WITHIN_ERROR, MISS_WORST_TIER, 'INVALID_AS_MISS:' followed by invalid_reason, or LATE_GATE_MISS; gate_status null unless the row is INVALID by a gate (ON-TIME for kind INVALID_AS_MISS, LATE for LATE_GATE_MISS; null for a built-in reason); near is false on HIT and INVALID rows, also on a row an envelope stop names (F1 and basis row T3: NEAR on tier-MISS rows only).

R_q.description: ECHO of the slots query block's Rad_text for the row, verbatim (Run.check_zone_table): a string Python float() reads as a finite radius in kpc inside the zone's range.

row_notes.const: D-2/A65.4: counted coefficient-grid uncertainty; not converted into a number; widens no sigma; changes no tier
row_notes.description: Module constant D2_NOTE, on every reference row of a non-blanked output.

near_label.description: Module constant NEAR_LABEL (V-F6, OC-32): printed beside every near entry, a defective row's included.

tier_key.description: The tier key compared across phases by item 11 (Run.score_output).

row_p1_fixed.description: A Phase-1 reference row whose kind is fixed (Run.score_output). sensitivity_band_overlap is invalid on every row in Phase 1 (C-I4).

tsr_flag.description: true on NGC3198-Q25 only; ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [TSR_FLAG_TABLE_MISMATCH]} on every row under that stop.

row_p2_fixed.description: A Phase-2 reference row whose kind is fixed (Run.score_output). ABSENT: no phase1_band key in Phase 2.

sensitivity_band_overlap.description: yes/no from sensitivity.rows[].band_overlaps_error_bar on a valid sensitivity row, invalid on an invalid one; ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [FIELD_DEFECT_SENSITIVITY]} on the rows a sensitivity stop names.

row_p1_defective.description: A Phase-1 reference row with a row or gate defect (kind not fixed; C-1.1 map). Every value field is the same {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} object. ABSENT: sensitivity_band_label is omitted on a defective row; near_label is printed (V-F6).

row_p2_defective.description: A Phase-2 reference row with a row or gate defect; as row_p1_defective without phase1_band.

row_blanked.description: A row under an 'every other' stop: id, zone and tier_key only (tier_key kept so that a later Phase-2 run can read it, Run._p1_ok).

rows_blanked.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output, 'every other' branch. ORDER: Q01..Q43.

band_entry.description: SOURCE: Run.band_column (C-1.1 Phase-1 band, M-16; the pin switch A142 item 4, A149). overlaps: yes iff the L1 band [lo, hi] meets the closed error bar [v - sigma, v + sigma], else no. ABSENT: overlaps {NOT_AVAILABLE: [one code]}; fd_noise_not_bounded is printed with yes/no and with Q01_Q02_ALWAYS_NOT_AVAILABLE, L1_ROW_NOT_AVAILABLE, TARGET_PAIR_DEFECT, and omitted with L1_SHA_MISMATCH, L1_RECORD_DEFECT, PHASE1_TOOL_PIN_DEFECT, L1_ROW_DEFECT.

condition.const: conditional on A13 (the fixed DDO154 distance 4.04 Mpc and inclination 66 deg)

fd_noise_not_bounded.description: true iff the L1 row's fd_noise is the string FD_NOISE_NOT_BOUNDED.

zone_main.description: SOURCE: Run.zone_out over Run.engine (C-2 'Also reported for each zone'), plus labels. Counts, the two dominance flags and S_is_UNDEFINED print when they take one value over every allowed kind of the zone's defective rows (C-1.1 map); m and S print only for a zone without a defective row. N is the count of NEAR rows. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d}; N: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [the codes of the zone rows whose near is not available]}.

zones_main.description: ORDER: an object keyed by zone; the canonical bytes write its members in sorted key order INNER, OUTER, TRANSITION. The text's zone order (INNER, TRANSITION, OUTER; module constant ZONES) is the order of the rows, not of any printed list.

zone_twin.description: A classified twin's zone summary (Run.classify_twin, zone_out with twin=True): no defective row, so every value prints; N is 0 (no NEAR for an alternative).

outer_trend_main.description: SOURCE: Run.engine, printed by Run.score_output (C-2 outer trend). delta_out and far_half_median are numbers, or UNDEFINED when fewer than two OUTER rows carry a defined ratio. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when TRANSITION or OUTER has a defective row (GROWING and CROSSING print false instead when S(OUTER) is UNDEFINED for every assignment, the C-1.1 deduction).

patterns_main.description: SOURCE: Run.engine, Run.score_output (C-2 patterns P0-P15 with the flags P1g, P11g). Each pattern is true, false, or ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when undetermined over the defective rows; P10 reads {NOT_AVAILABLE: [TSR_FLAG_TABLE_MISMATCH]} under that stop. P13_sign_class present iff P13 is true; P8_reported_with present iff P8 is true (otherwise the keys are omitted). The object is keyed (sorted key order in the bytes).

P0_per_zone_per_reason.description: I per reason of each zone (as zones[Z].I_per_reason).

P8_reported_with.description: P8's mandatory companions: zones[Z].I and zones[Z].N.

note.const: never "all hit": INVALID rows still score as misses (C-4)

patterns_twin.description: A classified twin's patterns (Run.classify_twin): every value a boolean except P10, which is never evaluated for an alternative.

patterns_holding_main.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output. The pattern ids that print true. ORDER: the code's PATTERN_IDS order P0, P1, P1g, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10, P11, P11g, P12, P13, P14, P15 (not code-point order). ABSENT: [] when none holds.

patterns_holding_twin.description: As patterns_holding_main, for a twin (P10 never).

minority_miss.description: SOURCE: Run.engine, Run.score_output (C-3 MINORITY_MISS(Z)). ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when undetermined.

flagged_rows.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output (C-2 flagged-row list): every flagged row with its tier, INVALID included; the flagged set is {NGC3198-Q25}. ABSENT: the whole list reads {NOT_AVAILABLE: [TSR_FLAG_TABLE_MISMATCH]} under that stop; the tier reads {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} on a defective row.

part1_basic.description: C-3 part 1 (Run.readings): NOT_ADDRESSED with code PATTERN_NOT_HELD when every trigger prints false; CONSISTENT (code null) when a trigger holds; ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when undetermined.

part1_deficit.description: Part 1 of a deficit-type reading (R-UT1, R-REACH; C-3.2 sign rule): CONSISTENT iff S(OUTER) is DEFICIT or CENTERED and an OUTER MISS row has a negative ratio; else NOT_ADDRESSED with SIGN_SCOPE_EXCESS (P2 holds), SIGN_SCOPE_UNSIGNED (P14 holds) or SIGN_SCOPE_NO_DEFICIT_MISS (P11 holds and no OUTER MISS row is negative), checked in that order; PATTERN_NOT_HELD when the trigger prints false. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} otherwise.

part1_drift.description: Part 1 of R-DRIFT: INCONSISTENT when its trigger holds and DT-S0G reads AGAINST (C-6.3), CONSISTENT when it holds otherwise, NOT_ADDRESSED / PATTERN_NOT_HELD when it prints false. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d united with the STAGE0 state's codes}.

part2_mf.description: R-MF part 2: the E3 value with test E3_VERDICT_LINE (C-5.3; V-F2). ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d}.

part2_drift.description: R-DRIFT part 2 (Run.drift_part2, C-6.3 closed mapping): CONSISTENT or AGAINST with test DT-S0G; otherwise OPEN with code = the STAGE0 state and reasons = that state's codes (NOT_EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE: [NOT_IN_PHASE_1] in Phase 1, else the STAGE0 reasons; TWIN_INPUT_DEFECT: the defective source's reason [STAGE0_STATUS_RECORD_DEFECT] or [STAGE0_STATUS_BLOCK_DEFECT], else [FIELD_DEFECT_ALTERNATIVE] or []; EVALUATED_REFUSED, TWIN_INVALID, NOT_DECIDED: []). ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when OUTER has a defective row and STAGE0 was evaluated.

reading_R-TSR_blanked.description: R-TSR under TSR_FLAG_TABLE_MISMATCH (Run.readings): reading and labels with the NOT_AVAILABLE key beside them; ABSENT: every other reading key omitted.

readings.description: SOURCE: Run.readings (C-3, C-3.1, C-3.2): every registered reading, every time. ORDER: the C-3.2 table order (module constant READINGS): R-MF, R-UT1, R-REACH, R-HIST, R-DRIFT, R-S1, R-GRID, R-NAX, R-GEFF, R-ML, R-SPEC, R-GEO, R-TSR.

readings_p1.description: Phase 1: R-DRIFT part 2 is always OPEN, NOT_EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE, [NOT_IN_PHASE_1].

e3_line.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output (C-5.3 E3 line): the E3 value with S(OUTER), delta_out and the OUTER zone's counts. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} (N: as zones.OUTER.N); n_defined_ratio, n_late_gate, n_null_ratio read NOT_AVAILABLE whenever OUTER has a defective row.

descriptive.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output (C-3 descriptive lines). onset_radius: the TRANSITION or OUTER MISS row (LATE and null-ratio rows count, F3) with the smallest R_q, as {id, R_q}; NONE when there is none. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} when a defective row leaves it undetermined.

onset_comparison.const: k* (A12: wavelengths of tens of kpc), comparison only

invalid_list.description: SOURCE: Run.invalid_list (C-4, C-8 item 6). per_reason: {reason: [rows]} over rows of kind INVALID_AS_MISS and LATE_GATE_MISS (ORDER: row order Q01..Q43); GATE_AFTER_PREDICTIONS true iff the gate is LATE; gate_status null for a built-in reason. rows_not_available ORDER: sorted ids of the defective rows. ABSENT: rows_not_available_codes (codes_d, a plain sorted list) present iff rows_not_available is non-empty; outer_gas_cut_report present iff per_reason has QUERY_BEYOND_OUTER_GAS_CUT: ECHO of root_disclosures.outer_gas_cut_report (any non-null value), else {NOT_AVAILABLE: [CUT_REPORT_NOT_SUPPLIED]}.

outer_gas_cut_report.description: ECHO of root_disclosures.outer_gas_cut_report (any non-null value); ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [CUT_REPORT_NOT_SUPPLIED]} when the root disclosures are not an object or that value is missing or null.

a15.description: SOURCE: Run.a15 (C-5.1 E1, C-5.2 E2; labelled COMPARISON, never a fit, C-5.4).

a.description: INNER H, M, N (as zones.INNER) and the Q03-Q15 sub-table of tier and near (as the rows), with the NEAR gloss (V-F6). A HIT or INVALID_AS_MISS row prints near false (basis row T3).

E2.description: ABSENT: note present iff OUTER_NO_MISS is true.

note.const: OUTER_NO_MISS runs against the A15 E2 expectation

twin_row.description: A classified twin's row (Run.twin_row_out; C-6.1: tiered by M-T with its own INVALID set and the C-4 LATE rule).

twin_classification_43.description: SOURCE: Run.classify_twin for ORIGINAL_K, ML_3p6_0.4, ML_3p6_0.6 or GL10_SOURCE_GAUSS_ORDER: summaries and patterns by the C-2 rules with N(Z) = 0 and no P10. rows ORDER: Q01..Q43.

twin_classification_stage0.description: SOURCE: Run.classify_twin for STAGE0_GRID_OUTER (scope: the OUTER ids). rows ORDER: Q36..Q43. INNER and TRANSITION hold no row (counts 0, m and S UNDEFINED).

alt_e_na_phase1.description: ORIGINAL_K in Phase 1 (I-4 rule before the twin rule, M-10): the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE as status, with its reason.

alt_e_na_changed.description: ORIGINAL_K in Phase 2 when the score marks it other than EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE (A16.2).

alt_e_defect_codes.description: An alternative with a stop of class ALT (a missing, repeated or malformed alternative, or a twin field defect): TWIN_INPUT_DEFECT with the alternative's stop codes.

alt_e_not_scored.description: Not evaluated before the freeze, or not scored, or DDO154_DISTANCE_NUISANCE: the score's status (ECHO, one of the two words) with the C-6.2 note.

note.const: NOT_EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE: sensitivity only, never scored as the headline

alt_e_not_scored_evaluated.description: ORIGINAL_K marked EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE but not scored.

note.const: NOT_EVALUATED_BEFORE_FREEZE: sensitivity only, never scored as the headline

alt_e_twin_invalid.description: The twin's member_valid is false (C-6.1; not a defect). member_within_error_counts: ECHO of the alternative's own field when an object; ABSENT: the bare string NOT_AVAILABLE otherwise.

alt_e_twin_defect_detail.description: The twin's ids differ from its scope (C-6.1 alone, no stop).

detail.const: twin ids differ from its scope

note.const: never triggers, confirms or refutes a PRIMARY reading (C-6.1)

alt_stage0_defect.description: The STAGE0 entry under a STAGE0 defect: Run.alternatives_out copies status, reasons and twin of the stage0 object, so a record defect reads [STAGE0_STATUS_RECORD_DEFECT] and a block defect [STAGE0_STATUS_BLOCK_DEFECT]; source and defect are not copied.

alt_STAGE0_GRID_OUTER.description: The STAGE0 entry of the alternatives list: the keys status, reasons, twin and label of the top-level stage0 object, those present (Run.alternatives_out).

alternatives_list.description: SOURCE: Run.alternatives_out (C-6.1, C-6.2, C-I4; never the headline). ORDER: ORIGINAL_K, ML_3p6_0.4, ML_3p6_0.6, GL10_SOURCE_GAUSS_ORDER (module constant ALT_ORDER, the C-I4 table order after BR_A_F10_PRIMARY, which is never listed), then DDO154_DISTANCE_NUISANCE only when the score's alternatives[] names it, then STAGE0_GRID_OUTER last. The order is the code's constant; it is not read from the slots file.

alternatives_p1.description: Phase 1: ORIGINAL_K reads NOT_AVAILABLE (I-4) and STAGE0 its Phase-1 form.

stage0_sensitivity_label.const: SENSITIVITY: coefficient-grid sensitivity at fixed calibrated parameters (A65), not a recalibration
stage0_sensitivity_label.description: Run.stage0_block, when the STAGE0 twin is classified.

comparison_na.description: DT-S0G not computed because OUTER has a defective reference row: {NOT_AVAILABLE: codes_d} with labels beside it (Run.score_output adds labels to the na() object).

comparison_classified.description: SOURCE: Run.s0g_compare (C-6.3 comparison, M-9 as ruled) plus result and labels. qualifying_rows ORDER: row order (OUTER rows non-INVALID under both members with a defined ratio under both); rows ORDER: the same. ABSENT: with no qualifying row the counts are 0, A_P and A_S are UNDEFINED, result is NOT_DECIDED and the rows key is omitted.

stage0_p1.description: SOURCE: Run.stage0_block, Run.score_output (Phase 1). ABSENT: comparison null.

stage0_p2.description: SOURCE: Run.stage0_status, Run.stage0_block, Run.score_output (C-6.3, M-14, F8, F12), Phase 2. Eight cases: a record defect, a block defect (successor mode), and six cases read from the facts, which carry the keys and the cross-field rules of stage0_status_read (source, post_score_exploratory, the times as ECHO). ABSENT: comparison null unless the STAGE0 twin was classified; source omitted only in the record defect; defect present only in the block defect; twin, twin_detail, label, twin_classification, stage0_within_error_distribution and denominator present only in the cases named.

oneOf.description: STAGE0 status record missing or malformed (F8: read as a field of the STAGE0 alternative).
The frozen stage0_status block not bound or malformed (successor mode; F8: read as a field of the STAGE0 alternative): the keys of stage0_status_block_defect, with twin and comparison.
EVALUATED_REFUSED: a receipt refusal or an evaluation refusal is recorded while the rule holds (Run._stage0_facts); from the block only.
Evaluated, but the STAGE0 alternative has a stop of class ALT.

Evaluated; the twin is TWIN_INVALID (twin_detail null) or its ids differ from its scope (TWIN_INPUT_DEFECT, twin_detail 'twin ids differ from its scope'; the code's default word 'absent' is kept here but is not reachable from Run.prepare_alternatives).

enum: twin ids differ from its scope
twin ids differ from its scope

oneOf.description: Twin classified, but OUTER has a defective reference row: DT-S0G not computed.

stage0_within_error_distribution.description: n: the twin's row count (8); within_error: its HIT rows.

c3_record.description: M-13: the T120L C3 record (C3_max_e finite, C3_PASS boolean; ECHO) with two fixed disclosures. ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [C3_RECORD_NOT_AVAILABLE_M13]} when the record or either field is missing or malformed.

p8_report_p1.description: SOURCE: Run.p8_report (C-3.2 P8, M-13). ABSENT: null unless patterns.P8 is true.

note.const: changes neither the headline nor any status

p8_report_p2.description: SOURCE: Run.p8_report. ABSENT: null unless patterns.P8 is true; ORIGINAL_K_twin_OUTER reads {NOT_AVAILABLE: [ORIGINAL_K_TWIN_NOT_CLASSIFIED]} when ORIGINAL_K's twin was not classified.

agree_defect_word.description: SOURCE: Run.parse_agree (and the load error of the agree_record input). The words, in the order the checks run: a load error (NOT_SUPPLIED, UNREADABLE, SHA_MISMATCH, JSON_DEFECT:<word>), PHASE1_TOOL_PIN_DEFECT, MODULE, AT0_RECORD, AT0B_MEMBERS_SHA256, AT0B_VALUES_SHA256, SCHEMA, OUTCOME, MISSING:<key>, NON_DISCRIMINATING_ROWS, FAILING, FAILING_ENTRY, FAILING_KEYS_V003A, CATEGORY, REGION_ROWS_VIOLATED, CATEGORY_MAPPING, REGION_MAX_VIOLATION, PARTS, FLAG_OR_FLAG_REASON, FAILING_KEYS_V002, FAILING_VALUES, SUPERSEDED_WITHOUT_FAILING, COVERED_WITH_FAILING, REPORTED_KEYS and the v003a reported words (Run._reported_v003a_defect).

agreement_defect.description: A defective agree record (C-8 item 11): no outcome; Phase 1 keeps its PROVISIONAL label. ABSENT: outcome {NOT_AVAILABLE: [AGREE_RECORD_DEFECT]}; non_discriminating_rows, failing_member_rows, target_free_always_reported, agree_schema and cross_phase are omitted.

flag_pair.description: phase1_c2v003a flag/flag_reason pairs (Run._flag_pair_ok): (null, null) bounded; (FD_NOISE_NOT_BOUNDED, NO_ROW_EPS_Q) a row without eps_q; (MEMBER_POINT_NOISE_NOT_BOUNDED, a MEMBER_EPS_ reason).

failing_v002.description: A failing (member, row) entry under the d64351ec pin (phase1_c2v002): six keys.

failing_v003a.description: A failing (member, row) entry under the 7d891ff7 pin (phase1_c2v003b, which keeps the phase1_c2v003a encoding): eleven keys; category is the first violated family's category in the family order TRUST_RADIUS, BOX, LINEAR_DDO, NGC_NONLINEAR iff none is violated.

region_rows_violated.description: ORDER: the family order TRUST_RADIUS, BOX, LINEAR_DDO (REGION_FAMILIES), no repeats.

extent_entry.description: A band_region_extent / band_region_box_only_extent entry (Run._extent_list_defect): each bound is a number when its LP status is OPTIMAL and the string NOT_AVAILABLE (the phase1 tool's own word, ECHO) otherwise.

reported_v002.description: ECHO of the AT1 record's reported under the d64351ec pin: the seven v002 keys are required, their values and any further key are not checked.

reported_v003a.description: ECHO of the AT1 record's reported under the 7d891ff7 pin (phase1_c2v003b, which keeps the phase1_c2v003a encoding): exactly at1_rows' twelve keys. Six keys are checked (Run._reported_v003a_defect) and given here; the six v002-era keys other than e_q_per_member_row are not checked (any value). band_region_extent and band_region_box_only_extent run over the same directions in the same order (not expressible here). band_region_single_point is the string NOT_AVAILABLE iff some band-region program is not OPTIMAL, else true iff every extent is exactly [0.0, 0.0].

cross_phase_object.description: SOURCE: Run.agreement (C-8 item 11 target-dependent items). The phase1 values are ECHO of the Phase-1 classification input (classifier A's own Phase-1 output when honest; e3_lines.phase1 is null when that output's e3_line is a NOT_AVAILABLE object, which has no value key). rows_whose_tier_changed and rows_tier_comparison_not_available ORDER: Q01..Q43; a row is not comparable when either tier_key is an object.

agreement_record.description: SOURCE: Run.agreement, Run.parse_agree (C-8 item 11 [r3a]; F2; A144, A149). The record is the AT-1 record, or, when AT-1 did not run, the AT-0a/AT-0b record that reports AGREEMENT_DEFECT. non_discriminating_rows and failing_member_rows ORDER: the record's order (ECHO after checks; [] when the record has none). target_free_always_reported: the record's reported, ECHO; ABSENT: {NOT_AVAILABLE: [NOT_RUN_UNDER_AGREEMENT_DEFECT]} when the record has none (AT-0 records; an AT-1 AGREEMENT_DEFECT record without it). at0b_members_sha256 and at0b_values_sha256 only for an AT-0b record under the 7d891ff7 pin (phase1_c2v003b), and then both: ECHO of the record's members_sha256 and values_sha256, each checked as 64 lower-case hex (else AGREE_RECORD_DEFECT with AT0B_MEMBERS_SHA256 or AT0B_VALUES_SHA256). withdrawn only for SUPERSEDED. no_phase1_classification_reason only with cross_phase {NOT_AVAILABLE: [NO_PHASE_1_CLASSIFICATION]}. The output does not print which phase1 tool pin was bound; the failing-entry key set and the at0b_members_sha256 and at0b_values_sha256 pair show it.

no_phase1_classification_reason.description: ECHO of phase_inputs.phase1_classification_absent_reason when the bundle supplies no Phase-1 classification.

agreement.description: C-8 item 11, Phase 2 only (ABSENT: the key is omitted in Phase 1 and when the phase is null).

form_refused_bundle.description: SOURCE: classify_bundle on a BundleError from Run.load_bundle: the bundle is refused before any input is read. ABSENT: no other key.

reason.description: The first failing check in Run.load_bundle order: BUNDLE_UNREADABLE:<the OSError text, or the strict loader's word NOT_UTF8, DUPLICATE_KEY:<key>, NON_FINITE_CONSTANT:<NaN|Infinity|-Infinity>, NON_FINITE_NUMBER:<literal>, JSON_SYNTAX:<exception class name>>; BUNDLE_SCHEMA; BUNDLE_KEYS:<Python list repr of the sorted symmetric difference with the seven bundle keys>; BUNDLE_MODE; BUNDLE_INPUT_ROLES; BUNDLE_PIN:<role>; BUNDLE_ROSTERS; BUNDLE_SEALED; BUNDLE_SEALED_PINS; BUNDLE_PHASE1_TOOL; BUNDLE_MODULE_SHA.

form_refused_internal_error.description: SOURCE: classify_bundle, when Run.run (or the canonical serialisation of its result) raises any exception: fail closed, never a classification. reason: 'INTERNAL_ERROR: ' + the exception class name + ': ' + the first 300 characters of its message (Python's text, not the classifier's). ABSENT: no other key.

form_no_classification.description: SOURCE: Run.run (C-I7 'No classification, or no score of record'): a well-formed phase inputs record whose run_status is not SCORED. Returned before any stop is checked, in either mode. status_code is the run status: AT0A_FAILED only with PHASE_1 and HALTED only with PHASE_2 (a status of the other phase is refused as PHASE_MISMATCH instead, V-F5); NO_NGC_CALL with either. ABSENT: run_status_code null when the record has null.

run_status_code.description: ECHO of phase_inputs.run_status_code (for example the engine terminal status).

enum: no NGC call: no classification (engine terminal status or NO_IDENTIFIED_DIRECTION; A133 1.3)

note.const: no NGC call: no classification (engine terminal status or NO_IDENTIFIED_DIRECTION; A133 1.3)

form_prescore.description: SOURCE: Run.prescore_output (C-1.1 'Pre-score checks (binding)'): every stop checked on a synthetic score built from the frozen member arrays, before target access. result CLASSIFICATION_INPUT_DEFECT iff any stop fired (stops non-empty), else PASS. ABSENT: phase null when the phase inputs record is missing or malformed (OC-27); manifest_phase_derived null when the check stopped before deriving it; no header, labels or classification keys.

not_stop_inputs.description: The load status of the four inputs that never stop the classification.

form_score_blanked.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output with at least one ALL-class stop (C-1.1 'every other': every output except the header and the echoed headline; OC-19). status NOT_READ; status_code lists every stop code (all classes); each blanked item is the same {NOT_AVAILABLE: [the ALL-class codes]} object; rows keep id, zone and tier_key. ABSENT: agreement present iff phase is PHASE_2. header.phase equals phase.

form_score_phase1.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output, phase PHASE_1, no ALL-class stop (C-8 items 1-10; item 11 is Phase 2 only). status CLASSIFIED with status_code null and stops [], or NOT_READ with the codes of the stops that fired (classes TSR, GATE, ENVELOPE, ROW, ALT; the sensitivity column is not read in Phase 1). ABSENT: no agreement key; p8_report null unless patterns.P8 is true.

exploratory_readings.description: C-8 item 9: always the empty list.

form_score_phase2.description: SOURCE: Run.score_output, phase PHASE_2, no ALL-class stop (C-8 items 1-11). status CLASSIFIED with status_code null and stops [], or NOT_READ with the codes of the stops that fired (classes TSR, GATE, ENVELOPE, SENSITIVITY, ROW, ALT). ABSENT: p8_report null unless patterns.P8 is true.
